verdict: Spend is producing sales but leads have collapsed — only 2 leads in 28 days on $5,653 spent.
diagnosis: Purchases are working ($5,897 in sales on $5,653 spend), but the lead funnel has broken — cost per lead hit $12 with just 2 total leads.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads in 28 days
signals.detail: Total lead volume is critically low against $5,653 spent. The campaign is generating purchases but not filling the top of funnel.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend near 1.04x
signals.detail: Purchase value of $5,897 barely exceeds $5,653 in spend. Margin after product costs is likely negative.

signals.headline: Click-through rate strong at 5.05%
signals.detail: 2,415 clicks on 47,813 impressions shows the ad hook works. The problem sits after the click, not before it.

signals.headline: Only 138 landing page views from 851 link clicks
signals.detail: Roughly 84% of link clicks never load the page. Site speed or tracking is leaking most of the paid traffic.

signals.headline: Just 1 phone call in 28 days
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 120 direction requests but only one call. For a medical alert brand, phone intent should be far higher.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.subheader: Health cost per lead sits near $57
benchmark.body: Physicians and surgeons average $56.83 per lead at an 11.6% conversion rate in 2026. Liferun's $12 cost per lead looks strong on paper, but only 2 leads means the number is not reliable.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: The category grows about 10.5% yearly and is not seasonal. Adult children researching for aging parents drive most purchases, so summer softness is not the excuse here.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.subheader: Life Alert, Philips, ADT dominate search
competitor.body: Life Alert, Philips Healthcare, ADT and GreatCall lead the category. Bidding on the keyword 'life alert' puts Liferun in direct auction with the biggest brand-name spender in the space.

recommendations.title: Fix the click-to-landing-page gap
recommendations.detail: Only 138 of 851 link clicks became landing page views. Test page load speed on mobile and check that conversion tracking is firing correctly across devices.

recommendations.title: Rethink bidding on the term 'life alert'
recommendations.detail: Consider whether competing on a trademarked competitor name is worth the cost. Test non-branded terms like 'medical alert watch' or 'fall detection device' instead.

recommendations.title: Add a phone-call conversion path
recommendations.detail: One call in 28 days is very low for this audience. Worth testing call extensions, a click-to-call ad format, and a clearer phone number on the landing page.
